items.title: General Motors vs. Tesla: Which Is the Better Automotive Stock to Buy Going Into 2027?
items.summary: GM trades at 6.4x forward earnings while Tesla commands 236.8x, yet only one carries a debt-to-equity ratio near 2.1x. The gap raises a question about which risk investors are really paying for.

items.title: Can GM's Solar Projects Strengthen Manufacturing Cost Efficiency?
items.summary: General Motors is investing $550 million in two Michigan solar projects to secure predictable energy costs and advance its emissions reduction goals.

items.title: Rare Earth Wars: U.S. General Sounds Alarm Over China's Military Leverage
items.summary: China has already used its grip on rare earths against Western factories and U.S. defense firms. Now a retired four-star general is warning it will do so again, and he's saying it as a director of the company the Army selected to negotiate a dysprosium and terbium plant on one of its own bases.

items.title: GM invests $550M into solar projects to offset factory emissions
items.summary: The Detroit automaker said the projects could produce enough hours of electricity annually to power all three Michigan assembly plants.

items.title: Ford Motor (F) Brings In Marissa West To Lead Its 2029 Vehicle Refresh
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) hired former General Motors executive Marissa West as Vice President of Vehicle Programs. West will oversee Ford's vehicle development and lead a broad product portfolio refresh that runs through 2029. Her remit includes new electric models and midsize pickup trucks across both commercial and consumer product lines.
